title: Customs Fees of Turkmenistan
text:
№

Kinds of Customs fees

Customs fees amount

1.

customs fees for customs clearance - (except for customs regimes of destruction, refusal in favor of the state, customs transit)

In the amount of 0.2% of the customs value of goods

2.

For customs escort

In the amount of 0.2 base rate used for calculating taxes and fees for each hour of work of a customs officer

3.

customs fee for storage- (except for the customs regimes of destruction and denial in favor of the state)

in the amount of 0.3% of the customs value of the goods for each day

Note:  For calculating customs fees, not full hour is equal to full and not full day is taken as full.
